ticketCategories.name: BebraCup 2026 Team Registration
ticketCategories.description: Register one team for BebraCup 2026. Staff will review the roster manually.
ticketCategories.ticketMessage:
⚠️ __**REGISTRATION IS NOT COMPLETE YET**__

To complete registration, __**send your roster in this channel**__.

__**ROSTER — REQUIRED**__
**One player per line**, using this format:
`Discord mention | CS2 nickname | Steam profile link`
**Include every player, including the captain.**

**TEAM LOGO — OPTIONAL**
Attach your logo here as an image.

**PLAYER PICTURES — OPTIONAL**
Attach a picture for each player you want shown on stream. Send each picture in a separate message and include that player's CS2 nickname in the message so staff can match it to the roster.

⚠️ __**Without the roster, staff cannot complete your registration.**__
Staff will review the details and register your team manually.
